facts.fact: The LCA/ITU State of ICT in Lesotho review reports from a nationally representative survey run by the Lesotho Communications Authority in late 2016 that internet access stands at 32.7% (close to 65% of the population have not accessed the internet); it gives no age range and words the figure as access, not use.
facts.system: LCA national ICT access and use household survey 2016

note: The 32.7% is worded as internet access in a survey of individuals and the document's own text on non-users supports reading it as use; basis slightly in doubt. The same survey is given as 32.5% in the 2025 LCA comparative report.
